selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the main claim made about the Sacred Law brought by the Prophet in this passage?
questions.answer: It is presented as unmatched in its kind and excellence, with no equal in existence or possibility.

questions.question: What time span is used to support the greatness of the Law he brought?
questions.answer: Fourteen centuries.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the fairness of that rule?
questions.answer: It describes it as just and exact.

questions.question: In what ways is Islam described as benefiting believers in every century?
questions.answer: It guides and shelters them, teaches their minds, lights and cleanses their hearts, trains their souls, and helps their spirits grow.

questions.question: What made the Prophet’s worship stand out besides being first in practice?
questions.answer: He lived it with the highest piety and with full awareness of its deepest meanings.

questions.question: Which two inner qualities are directly connected to his worship?
questions.answer: God-consciousness and fear of Allah.

questions.question: What makes his worship especially remarkable during difficult times?
questions.answer: He kept up complete and profound worship even while living with constant struggle and activity.

questions.question: Who are said to be unable to equal his degree of gnosis?
questions.answer: All the saints and knowers of Allah who came after him, even working together.

questions.question: Why is the comparison with later saints important?
questions.answer: It strengthens the claim that his understanding of Allah was greater than theirs.

questions.question: Why is the beginning of the Treatise On Supplicatory Prayer mentioned?
questions.answer: It is given as a place where a reader can see part of the meaning and greatness of the Jawshan al-Kabir.

questions.question: What overall picture of the Prophet does this passage build?
questions.answer: It presents him as unique in law, religion, worship, spiritual knowledge, and prayer.

questions.question: What reason is given for the excellence of the Sacred Law?
questions.answer: It has governed a vast portion of humanity for centuries in a fair and careful way.

questions.question: What does the phrase about one fifth of humanity help the reader understand?
questions.answer: It helps the reader see the vast reach and historical strength of that Law.

questions.question: What does the passage say Islam does for people’s intellects?
questions.answer: It teaches and educates them.

questions.question: How is Islam portrayed in relation to the soul and spirit?
questions.answer: It disciplines the soul and helps the spirit move forward and develop.

questions.question: How does the passage portray the Prophet as a model of worship?
questions.answer: It presents him as the earliest, most complete, and most reverent practitioner of all its forms.

questions.question: Which inner attitude toward Allah is highlighted in his worship?
questions.answer: Strong piety and reverent fear of Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage say this prayer collection reveals about him?
questions.answer: It reveals an unmatched level of spiritual knowledge and precise praise of Allah.

questions.question: What skill of the Prophet is especially highlighted through the Jawshan al-Kabir?
questions.answer: His ability to know, praise, and describe his Sustainer in an extraordinary way.

questions.question: What is the purpose of mentioning one of the ninety-nine sections of the Jawshan al-Kabir?
questions.answer: To point readers to an example that displays its richness and uniqueness.

questions.question: What subjects are used in this passage to demonstrate the Prophet’s uniqueness?
questions.answer: His Sacred Law, Islam, worship, supplications, and knowledge of Allah.

questions.question: In what practical area of life is the Sacred Law said to have shown its excellence?
questions.answer: In ruling and organizing human life over a large community across many centuries.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is the source from which Islam emerged?
questions.answer: It came forth from the Prophet’s actions, words, and inner spiritual condition.

questions.question: What does the word “refuge” suggest about Islam’s role for believers?
questions.answer: It gives them protection, stability, and a place of safety in life.
